## 黑着跑 BlankRun v0.1.1

**中文**

这一版修了一个会让屏幕自己黑掉的 Windows 问题，加了自动更新和息屏记录，并把防误触做得更彻底。

修复
- **Windows：屏幕在没息屏时自己黑掉 / 黑亮来回闪**。v0.1.0 把「关显示器」消息广播给了所有窗口，被挂起的 UWP 应用（设置、开始菜单等）会把它攒着，几分钟后再执行。现在只发给黑着跑自己的隐藏窗口。
- **Mac 键盘背光**：唤醒后有时没恢复（读回 0）。现在亮屏后会再确认几次。
- **Windows 托盘图标**：切换任务栏浅色/深色后会自动换颜色。
- **按键卡住**：息屏前就按着的修饰键（比如刚按的 Ctrl+Alt+B），松开时不再被拦，别的程序不会以为 Ctrl/Alt 一直按着。

新功能
- **自动更新**：每天检查一次（「设置 › 关于」里可以关，也可以手动「检查更新」）。有新版本时面板和设置里会安静地提示，点「更新并重启」才下载安装；安装包有签名校验；息屏中不会更新。
- **息屏记录**：「设置 › 关于」里列出最近 30 次息屏：时间、时长、触发方式（手动/快捷键/计划）、怎么结束的（唤醒方式/紧急键/时段结束/异常退出后恢复）、拦下了几次误触。只存在本机，可以清空。
- **「息屏时防止电脑睡眠」开关**（默认开）：关掉后按系统自己的睡眠设置走，关屏、拦截输入、唤醒都不变；息屏中切换立即生效。
- **首次启动欢迎页**：说明怎么息屏、怎么唤醒、怎么设定时，托盘图标在哪（Windows 上被折叠进 ^ 时怎么找）。之后从开始菜单/启动台打开会直接显示设置。
- **息屏中碰到键鼠的提示**：更大更清楚，只显示在光标所在的屏上，至少停留 5 秒，连续碰会延长，不闪烁。远程控制软件、屏幕键盘发来的输入也一并拦下。
- 「关于」页加了官网和 GitHub 链接；官网加了分享图和 SEO 信息。

升级须知
- **从 v0.1.0 升级需要手动下载安装这一次**（v0.1.0 还没有自动更新）。之后的版本会自动提示。
- **Mac**：安装包是临时签名，每次更新后都要在「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性」里重新打开**辅助功能**和**输入监控**（先删掉旧的黑着跑条目再添加）。首次打开仍需右键 › 打开。
- **Windows**：安装包未签名，SmartScreen 提示时点「更多信息 › 仍要运行」。装在自定义目录的，选同一个目录覆盖即可，设置都会保留。

---

**English**

This release fixes a Windows bug that could turn the screens off on its own, adds auto-update and blank history, and makes input blocking more thorough.

Fixes
- **Windows: screens going dark (or flickering) when nothing was blanked.** v0.1.0 broadcast the "monitor off" message to every window, and suspended UWP apps (Settings, Start, …) replayed it minutes later. It is now sent only to BlankRun's own hidden window.
- **Mac keyboard backlight** sometimes stayed off after waking (read back as 0). It is now re-checked a few times once the display is on.
- **Windows tray icon** now switches colour when the taskbar changes between light and dark.
- **Stuck keys**: modifiers that were already held when blanking started (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+B) are released normally, so other apps don't think Ctrl/Alt is still down.

New
- **Auto-update**: checks once a day (turn off or "Check for updates" in Settings › About). New versions are announced quietly in the popover and settings; nothing is downloaded until you click "Update and restart". Packages are signature-checked, and updates never run while the screen is blank.
- **Blank history**: Settings › About lists the last 30 sessions with time, duration, trigger (manual/hotkey/schedule), how each ended (wake method, emergency key, schedule end, recovered after a crash) and how many accidental touches were blocked. Stored locally; can be cleared.
- **"Keep computer awake while blanked" toggle** (on by default). Turn it off to let the system's own sleep settings apply; display off, input blocking and wake are unchanged. Changing it while blank applies immediately.
- **First-run welcome**: how to blank, wake and schedule, and where the tray icon is (including Windows' hidden-icons ^). Later launches from the Start menu / Launchpad open Settings.
- **Hint when you touch input while blank**: larger and clearer, shown on the screen under the cursor, visible for at least 5 seconds and extended on repeated touches, no flicker. Input from remote-control tools and on-screen keyboards is blocked too.
- About page links to the website and GitHub; the website gained a share image and SEO metadata.

Upgrading
- **Coming from v0.1.0, install this version manually once** (v0.1.0 has no updater). Later versions are offered automatically.
- **Mac**: builds are ad-hoc signed, so after every update re-enable **Accessibility** and **Input Monitoring** in System Settings › Privacy & Security (remove the old BlankRun entry, then add it again). First launch still needs right-click › Open.
- **Windows**: the installer is unsigned; on SmartScreen choose "More info › Run anyway". If you installed to a custom folder, pick the same folder; your settings are kept.
